intrinsic_activity.value: 2-3 times higher than PtNi without IL

nodes.source_text: The intrinsic activity of these composite electrocatalysts for oxygen reduction was found to be 2–3 times higher than those of PtNi catalysts without IL, and dramatically 10 times higher than that of the commercial Pt/C catalyst.
the enhanced activity of the IL-modified sample can be stabilized up to 30,000 electrochemical potential cycles. The degraded SCILL sample is still far more active than the fresh Pt/C.
an impressive overall cell efficiency of 67% can be obtained in a H2-O2 fuel cell device using the [C4mim][BF4] as electrolyte
